svg.title: Sinozia Character Swap Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: Full backend pipeline from video upload through Kling AI final video generation, showing Laravel and Python layers

g.text: Laravel Layer — Auth, Credits, Jobs, API Endpoints
Python Worker — FFmpeg · LLM · NanoBanana · Kling · ElevenLabs
Base image + target image + prompt → preview image (free)
Original video + preview image → final video (~5 min)
Audio extract → voice clone → remix with video
